Before this goes live

This is a concept built from public listings, so a few things need the shop's word first.

  1. Phone and email. Yelp displays a tracking number, so this page uses (619) 207-5910 from the shop's own posts and BBB. Is that still the one to call?
  2. Permission for the photos. Everything here came from the shop's own Yelp uploads. Nothing goes on a real domain without an OK.
  3. Who's here now. Current artists, handles, portraits and bios, and which credits in the gallery still apply.
  4. Newer work. Most of these uploads are from 2017 to 2020. The Instagram feed would fix that, and I haven't seen it.
  5. Friday, November 13. Whether it's on, and the details.
  6. Prices, deposits, age and ID, aftercare. All in the shop's own words.
  7. Piercing. How it should be described, if at all.
  8. The logo file. This one comes from a 2016 upload. A source file would be sharper.
  9. A web address. The site link on the BBB profile returns an error. inkmindsetstudios.com looked unclaimed on November 1, 2026.
